contract.purpose: Help one job seeker tailor a resume for one role without inventing claims, then preserve an inspectable application record.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md plus current implementation, pricing, authentication, and apply-flow source
contract.canonicalPurpose: Evidence-bound resume tailoring and review-first application preparation for one specific job.
contract.audience: A careful job seeker who wants a role-specific application without losing control of factual claims or submission.
contract.job: Compare a role with existing evidence, make defensible wording changes, review the packet, and stop safely before submission when anything is uncertain.
contract.thesis: Resume tailoring is more trustworthy when every change can be traced to source evidence and the applicant keeps the final decision.
contract.system: A paper workbench pairs role requirements, evidence-backed patches, a dossier, review controls, token-pack access, and a final receipt.
contract.signature: The redline patch and safe-stop receipt make evidence and human control visible rather than describing them abstractly.
contract.risk: Avoid implying unattended application submission, invented claims, a subscription, or a currently verified live checkout transaction.

answers.product: RolePatch is an evidence-bound resume tailoring and application-preparation tool for one job at a time.
answers.audience: It is for job seekers who care about truthful claims and want to retain submission control.
answers.value: It turns an existing resume and evidence stash into a role-specific packet without fabricating experience.
answers.mechanism: It maps requirements to evidence, proposes inspectable patches, assembles a dossier, and records a reviewed receipt.
answers.proof: The page shows a sourced patch, requirement map, dossier contents, token boundaries, and a safe-stop receipt.
answers.nextAction: Start tailoring in the browser, then use AI only when a signed-in applicant chooses to spend tokens.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner explicitly delegated final design judgment and asked the portfolio pass to continue without repeated feedback pauses.
